svg.title: CONTAINERS & KUBERNETES
svg.desc: Containers and Kubernetes: a Flask API running as 5 replicas behind a LoadBalancer Service on Minikube, with images published to Docker Hub (python-flask-microservice, flask-ocr). Maps to EKS/ECS at work.
